How this was made

On the afternoon of October 11, 2026, six AI research agents (Claude) read the Transformation 250 guest booklet, then worked in parallel through public Form 990s, organization websites, annual reports, and news coverage. Each wrote a structured brief for every organization in this room.

What a development officer would do with this, step by step:

  1. Hand the agent a list of names and a clear brief (what to find, what to skip, how to cite).
  2. Let it read public sources: 990s, websites, news, and bios.
  3. Get back a structured brief, with every figure linked to its source.
  4. Have a person check it before anyone acts on it.

Guardrails used here: organization-level research only. No personal wealth, giving capacity, family, or political giving. Figures come from the most recent public filings (FY2023 to FY2025) and may lag. Treat every brief as a starting draft to verify.

Built for Stephen Rowe’s session, “The Future of Fundraising.” stephen@digitalrowe.com
